rationale: A polite request remains a concrete three-second walking command; politeness must not hide the action or its duration.

primary_outcomes: Understand the polite utterance as one forward-walk request and preserve the explicit three-second duration.
acceptable_auxiliary: Natural acknowledgement may vary and may be omitted when the runtime contract does not require speech.
forbidden_semantic_outcomes: Treat politeness as non-actionable small talk.
Drop or change the requested duration.
